# playground commands

Every `playground` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `playground:reset`

Wipe and reseed all playground-owned data. Refuses outside dev. Requires --yes.

```bash
bin/semitexa playground:reset
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--yes` | no |
| `--dry-run` | no |
